title: A vanishing inverse-image unit is detected at a coefficient stage
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder in Type u, S_i spectral spaces, f_ij spectral transition maps satisfying identity and composition, and (X,p_i) their topological inverse limit. Let F_i be Ab.{max u v}-valued sheaves and let α_ij:F_i→(f_ij)_*F_j be arbitrary sheaf morphisms, with no coherence assumption. For j∈I, a compact open V⊆S_j and s∈F_j(V), if the inverse-image unit of s is zero in (p_j⁻¹F_j)(p_j⁻¹V), then there are l≥j such that α_jl,V(s)=0 [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image].

source.place: Tags 008H and 0A32, zero/equality detection in inverse-image sections; Topology, Tag 0A30(2).

proof.text: At each image point p_j(x), the map to the skyscraper sheaf of the coefficient fiber factors through the pullback unit by adjunction. Hence its value on s is zero, its germ is zero, and filtered-colimit equality gives a neighborhood on which s restricts to zero.

The spectral inverse-limit theorem makes the pulled-back open compact. Refine the neighborhoods of coefficient image points by compact opens at stage j and take finitely many of their inverse images covering the limit open. Their union A is compact open.

Descend the inclusion of the pulled-back domain in the pulled-back A. At the resulting stage, naturality of α makes its image of t zero on a covering family, and sheaf separation makes α_jl(s) zero globally. If the limit open is empty, the same argument uses the empty finite subcover.

proof_origin.place: Tags 008H and 0A32, zero/equality detection in inverse-image sections; Topology, Tag 0A30(2).; source argument expanded in the displayed Lean proof and docstring by W3.

mathlib_searches.query: For an inverse system of spectral spaces, a coefficient section whose inverse image is zero becomes zero at a finite stage, and every section on the limit is represented at a finite stage
mathlib_searches.results: AffineTransitionLimit has analogous results for scheme structure sheaves, not arbitrary abelian sheaf systems.

mathlib_searches.query: A section of an inverse image sheaf on a spectral inverse limit is represented by a section at a finite stage
mathlib_searches.results: Affine scheme and ring-valued structure-sheaf results; none applies to arbitrary abelian sheaves.

from.place: General cohomological continuity used after constructing the punctured inverse system: sections on quasi-compact opens are represented and identified at a finite stage.

theorem spectralLimit_unit_eventually_zero
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (S : I → TopCat.{u}) [∀ j : I, SpectralSpace (S j)]
    (f : ∀ (j k : I), j ≤ k → (S k ⟶ S j))
    (hf : ∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k), IsSpectralMap (f j k h))
    (hfid : ∀ j : I, f j j le_rfl = 𝟙 (S j))
    (hfcomp : ∀ (j k l : I) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hkl : k ≤ l),
      f k l hkl ≫ f j k hjk = f j l (hjk.trans hkl))
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (p : ∀ j : I, X ⟶ S j)
    (hpcomp : ∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k), p k ≫ f j k h = p j)
    (hlimit : ∀ a : ∀ j : I, S j,
      (∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k), f j k h (a k) = a j) →
      ∃! x : X, ∀ j : I, p j x = a j)
    (htop : X.str = ⨅ j : I, TopologicalSpace.induced (p j) (S j).str)
    (F : ∀ j : I, (S j).Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})
    (alpha : ∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k),
      F j ⟶ (pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (f j k h)).obj (F k))
    (j : I) (V : Opens (S j)) (hVc : IsCompact (V : Set (S j)))
    (s : (F j).obj.obj (op V))
    (hs : (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
      (Opens.map (p j)) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (Opens.grothendieckTopology (S j))
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app (F j)).hom.app (op V)) s = 0) :
    ∃ (l : I) (hjl : j ≤ l), (alpha j l hjl).hom.app (op V) s = 0
